step_rows: class key: 4-limb compare x vs p-x (4), masked 4-limb subtract (8), select (2)
column and orbit slot: 64-bit shift by constant (1), table base + index (2)
sign bit: y low-limb test and key pack (3)
P-256 REDUCTION PREMIUM over the borrowed reference addition: 6 field muls x +30 insn (Solinas: 8 mul-adds + 20 add/carry, vs secp256k1's 4 mul-add fold)
loads/stores: 4 limb loads of J, 4 stores of S, 4 coefficient loads (20)
coefficient update mod n: 4-limb add plus conditional subtract
checkpoint: period-64 compare (4), 4-limb fingerprint compare (3), age (3)
trap escape lag-1: class compare vs previous (3), alternate-slot select (2), join (1)
trap escape lag-3: class compare vs the class two steps back (3), join (1)
DP fingerprint: 64-bit mix (4) and threshold compare (2)
counters: 64-bit length add (4), cap test (2), loop counter/branch (1)
